title: Flock’s Solved Story Hub Showcases Thousands of Crimes Solved, Missing People Found
summary: Explore 3,000+ real cases where law enforcement used Flock to solve crimes and reunite families. Search the interactive map for stories in your community.
body_markdown:
- Flock launched the Solved Story Hub, a public resource that shares real cases where law enforcement used Flock technology to solve crimes, find suspects, and reunite families.
- Visitors can use an interactive map to explore cases in their own communities, search by city or state, filter by crime type, and watch videos about the people behind the cases.
- In one featured case, Lynn, Massachusetts police used Flock technology to locate a stolen car with a 6-year-old child inside and recovered the child in about 39 minutes.


Behind every solved case is a story. A missing child brought home safely. A violent crime solved. A family getting answers.


Flock has launched a new public resource, the[Solved Story Hub](https://www.flocksafety.com/solved-stories) . It highlights thousands of real cases where law enforcement used Flock technology to solve crimes, locate suspects, and reunite families.


## **What is Flock’s impact in my community?**


The hub features an interactive map that allows visitors to explore cases in their own communities, search by city or state, and filter by crime type. It also includes featured stories. Videos take a closer look at the people and communities behind these cases.


## **A stolen car, a child inside: found in 39 minutes**


In Lynn, Massachusetts, for example, someone[drove off in a stolen car with a 6-year-old child still inside](https://www.flocksafety.com/solved-stories/lynn-police-use-flock-to-locate-stolen-car-with-child-inside-within-39-minutes) . Using Flock technology, officers located the suspect vehicle in a neighboring community. They safely[recovered the child in approximately 39 minutes](https://patch.com/massachusetts/swampscott/north-shore-police-credit-flock-cameras-helping-find-child-stolen-car#google_vignette) .


It's one of[thousands of stories](https://www.flocksafety.com/solved-stories) that show how technology can make a difference when every second counts.


## **More than 3,000 cases at launch**


At launch, the Solved Story Hub features more than 3,000 cases, each supported by publicly available reporting. But these stories represent only a small portion of the work law enforcement does every day. Many successful investigations never make the news, and Flock will continue adding new cases to the hub.


## **What was Flock’s impact in 2025?**


According to Flock's 2025 Impact Census, Flock technology supported more than 1 million investigations. Flock helped solve 20% of cleared cases in areas where the technology was deployed. And Flock helped officers locate more than 10,000 missing people.


Explore the Solved Story Hub at[flocksafety.com/solved-stories](http://flocksafety.com/solved-stories) .
